title: Now’s the Time to Watch This 366-Episode Anime & Its Sequel Before It Ends This Summer
content: There are many great anime to binge on Crunchyroll in 2026 , but there’s one that’s especially worth digging into this summer — even with 366 episodes and a sequel series to get through.
author: ComicBook

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Readies for First Blu-ray Release With New Look
content: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle is taking a major step forward to its highly requested streaming release with its first Blu-ray later this Summer, and a new promo is showing off a new look at what to expect from its launch.
author: ComicBook

title: Fairy Tail Revival Just Revealed Its First Look Ahead of Summer 2026 Debut
content: Fairy Tail is now in the works on a new revival from the original creator behind it all, and the first look at the new series has been revealed ahead of its debut coming later this Summer. Fairy Tail is one of the biggest and most successful action franchises out there today.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Bokutachi wa Benkyou ga Dekinai', 'Himesama "Goumon" no Jikan desu' Creators Launch New Manga
content: The 28th issue of Weekly Shounen Jump magazine has begun serializing a new manga drawn by Taishi Tsutsui ( Bokutachi wa Benkyou ga Dekinai ) and written by Robinson Haruhara ( Himesama "Goumon" no Jikan desu ), titled Animal Signal , on Monday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Atlus Reveals Persona 6 Game in New Teaser
content: Atlus announced during the "XBOX Games Showcase 2026" livestream on Sunday Persona 6 , a new entry in its role-playing game series. The game will launch for Xbox series X|S, Xbox on PC and on Xbox Game Pass. Persona 5 shipped for PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 3 in Japan in September 2016.
author: ANN

title: Black Clover Expanding on Ending With New Release After Finale (What to Know)
content: Black Clover is going to continue with an expanded ending after the release of its grand finale, and it’s time to get ready for what could be coming next. title: Persona 4 Revival Game Launches February 18, 2027
content: Atlus announced during the "XBOX Games Showcase 2026" livestream on Sunday Persona 4 Revival , a remake of its original 2008 role-playing game, will launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox series X|S, Xbox PC with Xbox Game Pass, and PC via Steam on February 18, 2027.
author: ANN

title: Major Crunchyroll Sci-Fi Fantasy Just Confirmed a Sequel After 12 Years
content: One major anime franchise now streaming with Crunchyroll has announced it’s kicking off Part 2 of the series 12 years after it all first began. The anime adaptation for Tsutomu Sato’s The Irregular at Magic High School has been one of the most successful anime debuts of the 2010s .
author: ComicBook

title: 38 Episodes of My Hero Academia Are About to Stream Completely For Free
content: Based on a beloved Weekly Shonen Jump manga written and illustrated by Kohei Horikoshi, the anime adaptation of My Hero Academia is commemorating its 10th anniversary. The manga reached its conclusion in 2024, and the anime followed a year later.
